purpose: Teach: オルガン/学童/祭壇/観覧/顕微鏡/プレビュー/ガーナ/売れ行き

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 葵さん、店内に、本気で、絶対、オルガンの曲、絶対、流すと、絶対、雰囲気、絶対、お洒落になるで
lines.en: Aoi, listen — if you played organ music in here, I'm telling you, it would make this place feel genuinely sophisticated.
lines.style: Energetic and conspiratorial, leaning forward. Kansai warmth with genuine enthusiasm. Quick, staccato hits on the repeated emphasis—building conviction with each repetition.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。学童保育の、本気で、絶対、お子様向け、絶対、葵で、絶対、特別メニュー、絶対、用意したいですね
lines.en: You know, I'd love to create a special kids' menu just for Aoi—something that really feels like it's designed with care for the younger crowd.
lines.style: Warm, thoughtful nod. Gentle enthusiasm. Speaking slowly enough to give the idea space to land. Respectful of Daichi's energy but grounded in genuine consideration.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 結婚式向けに、本気で、絶対、祭壇風の、絶対、装飾、絶対、葵で、絶対、提供しよか
lines.en: What if we set up a whole wedding package for you? Altar-style decorations, the full experience—should we go for it, Aoi?
lines.style: Playful and building momentum. Light, forward energy on the proposal. Daichi's Kansai brightness bubbling just beneath the surface. Ends on a genuine question mark—inviting her in.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。地域の、本気で、絶対、観覧車近く、絶対、新店舗、絶対、出してみたいですね、葵さん
lines.en: Yes, I've been thinking—there's that perfect spot near the Ferris wheel. Opening a new location there could really work, don't you think?
lines.style: Sincere forward-leaning energy. Quieter than before but still engaged. As if she's been turning this over in her mind. Measured pacing, like she's testing the idea out loud for the first time.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 食材の、本気で、絶対、顕微鏡レベルの、絶対、品質チェック、絶対、本気で、絶対、進めよか、葵さん
lines.en: Aoi, here's what I'm thinking—we need to take ingredient quality seriously. I mean really seriously. Microscopic attention to detail on every single one.
lines.style: Tone shifts to genuinely earnest. Slower pace now, more deliberate. Daichi's usual lightness drops away—this is about standards. Light, firm emphasis on the quality standards, like drawing a line in the sand.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。新メニューの、本気で、絶対、プレビュー、絶対、お得意様に、絶対、先に、絶対、見ていただきましょう
lines.en: Of course. You know what would be smart? A preview of the new menu for our best customers first—give them the first look before we roll it out.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured reflection. Speaking with quiet confidence. The pace is calm and considered, like she's already picturing how this would unfold. Generous in her tone—this is about honoring the regulars.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: ガーナ産チョコ、本気で、絶対、葵で、絶対、特別メニュー、絶対、開発しよか、葵さん
lines.en: Aoi, what if we developed a signature dish with Ghanaian chocolate? Something that's really ours, something special we could build the menu around?
lines.style: Daichi's excitement returns, but it's focused now. Warm and specific. Building on the earlier energy but grounded in a real idea. The repeated name-check is affectionate, almost playful—like he's testing if she's as excited as he is.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。葵の売れ行き、本気で、絶対、好調、絶対、続けていきたいですね、葵さん
lines.en: Yes. And honestly, Aoi has been doing so well—I want to keep building on that momentum, keep pushing forward together.
lines.style: Warm, genuine close. Soft gratitude underneath. Speaking with quiet satisfaction about what's already happening. The final note lands gently, like a door softly closing on a good conversation. Genuine affection for the partnership.
